title: Advancements Search
description: Adds a search bar to the advancements screen, quickly find any advancement.
body:
![advancementssearch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a845fae7eec12fd3d8e54cbac4b4fc39567fa24.gif) AdvancementsSearch is a client-side mod that adds an inline search bar to the advancements screen, solving these problems.

This is a NeoForge 1.21.1 port of diskria's Fabric mod [**AdvancementsSearch**](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancements-search).
It also adds **[**Better Advancements**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-advancements)** compatibility.


Original Fabric mod author: diskria
NeoForge port: Ayane
